heavy_rain.name: Heavy rain
guide: Stay away from riverbanks, valleys, underpasses and underground parking.
If you are in a basement or semi-basement home, move above ground before water comes in.
Never walk or drive through flooded roads, even if the current looks weak.
Residents of landslide-prone areas should evacuate early.
Switch off the main breaker and close the gas valve.

typhoon.name: Typhoon
guide: Stay indoors and keep away from windows.
Avoid signboards, construction sites and anything that can be blown away.
Residents of coasts, riverbanks and low-lying areas should evacuate early.
Prepare a flashlight and a power bank in case of a blackout.

storm_surge.name: Storm surge
guide: Leave the coast and low-lying areas for higher ground.
Do not go near breakwaters or coastal roads.
Follow evacuation announcements promptly.

tsunami.name: Tsunami
guide: Move away from the coast to high ground immediately.
Larger waves may follow the first one; do not return until the alert is lifted.
Do not evacuate toward rivers or streams.

strong_wind.name: Strong wind
guide: Stay away from signboards, street trees and construction fences.
Close the windows and keep away from them.
Bring items on balconies and rooftops indoors.

heavy_snow.name: Heavy snow
guide: Avoid going out; use public transport if you must.
Clear snow safely from greenhouses and weak roofs.
On icy roads, take short steps and keep your hands out of your pockets.

cold_wave.name: Cold wave
guide: Keep warm with a hat, scarf and gloves when going out.
Older people and children should limit outdoor activity and use a nearby warming center.
Insulate water meters and pipes so they do not freeze.

heat_wave.name: Heat wave
guide: Avoid outdoor activity between noon and 5 p.m.
Drink water often, even when you are not thirsty.
If you feel dizzy or have a headache, move somewhere cool and call 119.
Use a nearby cooling center.

earthquake.name: Earthquake
guide: While shaking, get under a sturdy table and protect your head.
When the shaking stops, shut off gas and power and open the door to secure an exit.
Use the stairs, not the elevator.
Outside, move to an open area away from buildings and poles (outdoor evacuation site).

dry.name: Dry weather
guide: Do not light fires or burn rubbish in mountains or fields.
Do not throw away cigarette butts carelessly.
Call 119 as soon as you spot a fire.

yellow_dust.name: Yellow dust
guide: Avoid going out; wear a KF80 or better mask if you must.
Keep windows closed and wash your hands and face when you get home.
Drink plenty of water.

high_seas.name: High seas
guide: Stay away from rocky shores and breakwaters.
Vessels should move to a safe harbor.
